content.text: {"score":0.62,"reason":"The output correctly identifies the visual composition (two brown rectangular blocks, navy background, white-outlined small rectangle changing from red to blue), and accurately grounds evidence at frames 0, 1, 2, and 4 with correct color descriptions. However, there are several notable mismatches: (1) The summary says the change happens 'between samples 1 and 2,' which is correct per frame indexing but described ambiguously as 'samples 1 and 2' rather than clearly between frames 1 and 2. This is actually correct. (2) Continuity is marked as 'intact' when the reference says 'broken' — the color change of the rectangle constitutes a continuity break. This is a significant error. (3) The tone is tagged as 'detached' when the reference says none — a minor invented tag. (4) The motion_tags include 'stillness' when the reference says none — technically there is no motion, but inventing a tag not in the reference is a minor issue. (5) The color_tags include 'red' but not 'blue' — the output mentions blue in text but doesn't include it in color_tags; however per the evaluation criteria, generic 'blue' may not be in allowed color_tags, so this is acceptable. (6) camera_tags only has 'static' but misses 'wide_master' from the reference. (7) The audio fields are empty, which is correct. The continuity_status being 'intact' instead of 'broken' is the most significant error, as the prop color change is the central event of this clip."}
